entries.name: Constant
entries.description: Produces a fixed control value for parameters that would otherwise remain unpatched.

params.label: Value
params.behavior: Moves a destination below or above its base value.

entries.name: Clock phase
entries.description: Converts absolute sample time into a repeating 0–1 event phase; swing changes alternate phase lengths.

params.label: Rate
params.behavior: Sets how often a new event begins.

params.label: Swing
params.behavior: Alternates longer and shorter event phases without changing the two-event duration.

entries.name: LFO
entries.description: Produces cyclic control motion from absolute time without carrying oscillator state between samples.

params.label: Rate
params.behavior: Sets the speed of repeated parameter motion.

params.label: Shape
params.behavior: Changes the motion from continuous curves to abrupt or ramped changes.

params.label: Depth
params.behavior: Sets the size of the modulation swing.

params.label: Offset
params.behavior: Moves the center of the control waveform.

entries.name: Event contour
entries.description: Turns a clock phase into an attack-and-decay amplitude or modulation contour.

params.label: Attack
params.behavior: Controls how quickly the event rises from silence.

params.label: Tail
params.behavior: Controls how long the event remains audible within each clock cycle.

params.label: Curve
params.behavior: Redistributes energy toward the start or body of the contour.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the control signal before it reaches another module.

entries.name: Oscillator
entries.description: Evaluates a periodic waveform for each output sample; its input is a phase offset, not integrated arbitrary FM.

params.label: Frequency
params.behavior: Sets the fundamental pitch. Changes apply to the next rendered GPU chunk.

params.label: Waveform
params.behavior: Changes the harmonic series produced by the source.

params.label: Pulse width
params.behavior: Changes pulse duty cycle; it mainly affects the Pulse waveform.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the oscillator before downstream processing.

params.label: PM depth
params.behavior: Scales a connected phase-modulation signal and spreads energy into sidebands.

entries.name: Hash noise
entries.description: Creates deterministic noise from the sample coordinate; rate and smoothing move it toward stepped control-like texture.

params.label: Update rate
params.behavior: Sets how frequently the random value changes.

params.label: Interpolation
params.behavior: Interpolates between neighboring random values.

params.label: Seed
params.behavior: Chooses a repeatable random sequence without changing its statistics.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the noise before downstream processing.

entries.name: FM / PM voice
entries.description: A bounded carrier–modulator phase network. Ratio sets sideband spacing; index sets their spectral spread.

params.label: Carrier
params.behavior: Sets the carrier pitch around which sidebands form.

params.label: Ratio
params.behavior: Integer ratios tend toward harmonic spectra; non-integers tend toward metallic spectra.

params.label: Index
params.behavior: Raises the number and strength of audible sidebands.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the PM voice before processing.

params.label: Index CV
params.behavior: Sets how strongly the connected input changes modulation index.

entries.name: Harmonic bank
entries.description: Sums a bounded set of partials, fading components near Nyquist so density and spectral slope remain controllable.

params.label: Fundamental
params.behavior: Sets the base frequency shared by all partials.

params.label: Partials
params.behavior: Adds progressively higher components to the spectrum.

params.label: Spectral tilt
params.behavior: Controls how quickly higher partials lose amplitude.

params.label: Stretch
params.behavior: Moves upper partials away from exact integer multiples.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized partial sum.

entries.name: VCA
entries.description: Uses a control signal to articulate an audio signal; the depth control crossfades between constant and modulated gain.

params.label: Base gain
params.behavior: Sets gain when no contour is connected or modulation depth is low.

params.label: CV depth
params.behavior: Sets how completely the control input replaces base gain.

params.label: Drive
params.behavior: Raises level into a soft ceiling, adding harmonics at high values.

entries.name: Ring modulator
entries.description: Multiplies two bipolar audio signals, replacing their original frequencies with sum-and-difference components.

params.label: Amount
params.behavior: Crossfades from the first input to full bipolar multiplication.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the ring-modulated result.

entries.name: Two-channel mix
entries.description: Combines two routes with an equal-power balance so the center does not collapse as quickly as a linear crossfade.

params.label: Balance
params.behavior: Moves continuously between the two connected signals.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the combined signal.

entries.name: 3-input Adder
entries.description: Adds three independent signal branches with separate weights, then applies energy compensation and a soft ceiling.

params.label: A weight
params.behavior: Sets the signed contribution of the first branch; zero mutes it and negative values subtract it.

params.label: B weight
params.behavior: Sets the signed contribution of the second branch; zero mutes it and negative values subtract it.

params.label: C weight
params.behavior: Sets the signed contribution of the third branch; zero mutes it and negative values subtract it.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the compensated sum before its soft ceiling.

entries.name: 3-input Multiplier
entries.description: Multiplies three bipolar branches, producing intermodulation components that none of the inputs contains alone.

params.label: Product
params.behavior: Moves from a quiet parallel sum into three-way intermodulation.

params.label: Drive
params.behavior: Raises the multiplied signal into a soft ceiling.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Sets the output level after multiplication.

entries.name: Wavefolder
entries.description: Reflects an overdriven waveform through a sinusoidal fold, adding upper harmonics as drive and fold increase.

params.label: Drive
params.behavior: Pushes more of the waveform across folding boundaries.

params.label: Fold
params.behavior: Crossfades between smooth saturation and reflected wavefolding.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Blends the unprocessed signal with the folded result.

params.label: Symmetry
params.behavior: Offsets the transfer curve, introducing even harmonics.

entries.name: Amplitude quantizer
entries.description: Rounds amplitude to a finite number of levels. Lower bit depths replace smooth motion with stepped distortion.

params.label: Bit depth
params.behavior: Sets the number of available amplitude levels.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Blends the clean and stepped signals.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the result after quantization.

entries.name: Equal-power pan
entries.description: Converts mono to stereo using sine/cosine gains; a control input can move the position around its base value.

params.label: Position
params.behavior: Moves the signal between the left and right channels.

params.label: CV depth
params.behavior: Sets how far the connected control signal can move the pan position.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales both output channels.

entries.name: Soft clip
entries.description: Compresses peaks with a rational transfer curve, raising harmonic density without a hard digital corner.

params.label: Drive
params.behavior: Pushes peaks farther into saturation and adds harmonics.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Blends the input with the compressed transfer curve.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Sets level after saturation.

entries.name: Spectral Acid
entries.description: Builds an acid-like oscillator by weighting a bounded harmonic bank around a movable spectral cutoff and resonance peak.

params.label: Fundamental
params.behavior: Sets the fundamental beneath the generated harmonic series.

params.label: Partials
params.behavior: Sets the maximum number of harmonics before the Nyquist fade removes upper components.

params.label: Spectral cutoff
params.behavior: Moves the spectral low-pass edge through the harmonic numbers; this is not a recursive filter.

params.label: Peak
params.behavior: Raises partials near the spectral cutoff to create an acid-like emphasis.

params.label: Tilt
params.behavior: Changes how quickly harmonic level falls with harmonic number.

params.label: Drive
params.behavior: Pushes the normalized partial sum into a soft ceiling.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the stereo oscillator result.

params.label: Cutoff CV
params.behavior: Sets how far a connected control signal moves the spectral cutoff.

entries.name: Modal Metal
entries.description: Restarts a bounded bank of scattered inharmonic modes at each event and gives higher modes progressively shorter decays.

params.label: Body pitch
params.behavior: Sets the first modal frequency.

params.label: Strike rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the closed-form modal response restarts.

params.label: Decay
params.behavior: Sets the low modes' exponential decay time.

params.label: Stiffness
params.behavior: Bends upper mode ratios with a quadratic stiffness term.

params.label: Modes
params.behavior: Sets how many damped sine modes are evaluated.

params.label: Mode tilt
params.behavior: Controls how quickly upper modes lose amplitude.

params.label: Strike CV
params.behavior: Crossfades the built-in decay toward a connected strike contour.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized modal sum.

entries.name: Particle Cloud
entries.description: Layers sixteen deterministic, windowed oscillator grains with per-grain pitch and stereo placement; it does not read recorded samples.

params.label: Center pitch
params.behavior: Sets the center frequency from which seeded grain pitches spread.

params.label: Grain rate
params.behavior: Sets the shared event grid; sixteen lanes are staggered across it.

params.label: Grain size
params.behavior: Sets the Hann-windowed duration of each oscillator particle.

params.label: Density
params.behavior: Sets the deterministic probability that each scheduled grain is active.

params.label: Pitch spread
params.behavior: Spreads seeded grain pitches symmetrically around the center.

params.label: Stereo spread
params.behavior: Moves grains toward their seeded left or right positions.

params.label: Seed
params.behavior: Selects a repeatable set of grain pitches, onsets, and positions.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized grain cloud.

entries.name: Vector Wavetable
entries.description: Reconstructs sine, triangle, and saw spectra from a bounded Fourier bank, then scans continuously between them without a table lookup.

params.label: Frequency
params.behavior: Sets the common fundamental of the Fourier reconstruction.

params.label: Spectral scan
params.behavior: Morphs from sine through triangle toward saw harmonic weights.

params.label: Harmonics
params.behavior: Sets the bounded Fourier series length before Nyquist fading.

params.label: Spectral tilt
params.behavior: Tilts the reconstructed spectrum after the wavetable scan.

params.label: Phase spread
params.behavior: Offsets upper-partial phase in opposite directions across stereo.

params.label: Scan CV
params.behavior: Sets how far a connected control signal moves through the spectra.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized stereo reconstruction.

entries.name: Formant Bank
entries.description: Weights source harmonics with three vowel-shaped Gaussian spectral peaks; it is spectral-envelope synthesis, not recursive filtering.

params.label: Fundamental
params.behavior: Sets the harmonic spacing beneath the formant envelope.

params.label: Vowel scan
params.behavior: Moves three spectral peaks through an A–E–I–O–U trajectory.

params.label: Harmonics
params.behavior: Sets how many harmonics can meet the formant peaks.

params.label: Bandwidth
params.behavior: Sets the width of all three formant regions.

params.label: Voice tilt
params.behavior: Controls the source spectrum beneath the vowel peaks.

params.label: Breath
params.behavior: Adds deterministic full-band breath to the harmonic voice.

params.label: Vowel CV
params.behavior: Sets how far a connected control signal moves the vowel scan.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized stereo formant bank.

entries.name: Procedural Kick
entries.description: Integrates a falling exponential pitch analytically, then combines the decaying sine body with a separately windowed click.

params.label: Event rate
params.behavior: Sets the internal repetition rate and converts event phase into seconds.

params.label: Body pitch
params.behavior: Sets the pitch reached after the initial fall.

params.label: Pitch drop
params.behavior: Sets how far above the body frequency the attack begins.

params.label: Body decay
params.behavior: Sets the exponential amplitude tail.

params.label: Click
params.behavior: Adds a very short seeded noise transient without changing the body oscillator.

params.label: Drive
params.behavior: Pushes body and click together into a soft ceiling.

params.label: External phase
params.behavior: Crossfades from the internal event phase to a connected phase signal.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the finished kick.

entries.name: Sample + Hold
entries.description: Derives deterministic random plateaus from the sample coordinate, with an optional end-of-step glide that requires no stored history.

params.label: Update rate
params.behavior: Sets how often a new deterministic value is chosen.

params.label: Seed
params.behavior: Chooses a repeatable held-value sequence.

params.label: Edge glide
params.behavior: Interpolates only near the end of each hold cell to soften discontinuities.

params.label: Polarity
params.behavior: Chooses a unipolar or bipolar random range.

params.label: Depth
params.behavior: Scales the held modulation range.

params.label: Offset
params.behavior: Moves the center of the held control values.

entries.name: Euclidean Gate
entries.description: Evaluates an integer modulo predicate on a repeating step grid to distribute gates as evenly as possible.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the pattern advances by one step.

params.label: Steps
params.behavior: Sets the number of positions in the repeating cycle.

params.label: Pulses
params.behavior: Sets the number of active steps; values above Steps are clamped to the cycle length.

params.label: Rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the accent position without changing the spacing family.

params.label: Gate width
params.behavior: Sets how much of each active step remains high.

params.label: Cycle accent
params.behavior: Separates the cycle start by lowering the other active gates while the first stays at Level.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the control value sent to another module.

entries.name: GPU Arpeggiator
entries.description: Selects scale degrees, swing timing, glide, and a click-safe gate from the absolute sample coordinate. Pitch and gate can fan out independently.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the GPU advances to another scale degree.

params.label: Pattern length
params.behavior: Sets the number of positions before the pitch pattern repeats.

params.label: Pattern
params.behavior: Changes how step positions are mapped into scale degrees.

params.label: Scale
params.behavior: Maps the integer pattern onto a pitch collection, including 0.5-semitone quarter-tone steps.

params.label: Range
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the generated degrees can occupy.

params.label: Glide
params.behavior: Interpolates toward the following pitch near the end of each step.

params.label: Swing
params.behavior: Alternates step lengths while preserving the duration of each two-step pair.

params.label: Seed
params.behavior: Selects deterministic random and folded pattern orderings.

entries.name: Hard Sync
entries.description: Maps a slave oscillator into each master cycle so the slave phase restarts at every master boundary.

params.label: Master pitch
params.behavior: Sets the audible fundamental and reset rate.

params.label: Sync ratio
params.behavior: Sets how many slave cycles are forced inside each master cycle.

params.label: Slave wave
params.behavior: Selects the waveform evaluated after phase resetting.

params.label: Pulse width
params.behavior: Changes duty cycle when the slave waveform is Pulse.

params.label: Ratio CV
params.behavior: Sets how strongly a connected control signal changes the slave ratio.

params.label: Stereo detune
params.behavior: Offsets the slave ratio slightly and oppositely in the two channels.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the hard-synced oscillator.

entries.name: Phase Distortion
entries.description: Bends the phase slope on either side of a movable split point while preserving one complete oscillator cycle.

params.label: Frequency
params.behavior: Sets the oscillator fundamental.

params.label: Phase bend
params.behavior: Sets where the split point lands in output phase, changing the two phase slopes.

params.label: Time split
params.behavior: Sets where the piecewise phase mapping changes slope.

params.label: Curve
params.behavior: Curves the mapped phase again for a broader range of spectra.

params.label: Bend CV
params.behavior: Sets how far a connected control signal moves the phase bend.

params.label: Stereo offset
params.behavior: Detunes the phase-distorted oscillators in opposite directions.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the stereo oscillator result.

entries.name: Bytebeat
entries.description: Turns explicit 32-bit shifts, masks, multiplication, and overflow into repeating lo-fi melody and rhythm.

params.label: Integer clock
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the integer time variable advances.

params.label: Clock ratio
params.behavior: Multiplies the integer clock rate without changing the formula.

params.label: Formula
params.behavior: Selects one of six explicit integer expressions.

params.label: Output bits
params.behavior: Sets the output mask and amplitude resolution.

params.label: Variation
params.behavior: Changes constants and time offsets inside the selected formula.

params.label: Variation CV
params.behavior: Sets how strongly a connected control signal changes the integer variation.

params.label: Stereo offset
params.behavior: Blends the mono formula with a time-shifted right-channel evaluation.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the intentionally discontinuous result.

entries.name: Polynomial / Chebyshev shaper
entries.description: Builds a bounded Chebyshev polynomial series from a clipped input; a normalized sine exposes the clearest harmonic-number relationship.

params.label: Order
params.behavior: Sets the highest Chebyshev polynomial evaluated by the bounded recurrence.

params.label: Input drive
params.behavior: Scales the signal before it is clamped to the polynomial's −1 to 1 domain.

params.label: Series tilt
params.behavior: Controls how quickly higher polynomial orders lose weight.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Blends the original input with the Chebyshev series.

params.label: Bias
params.behavior: Offsets the transfer curve and introduces even-harmonic and DC components.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the shaped result.

entries.name: AM / Tremolo
entries.description: Multiplies one incoming signal by a continuous low- or audio-rate waveform, moving from tremolo into carrier-retaining AM sidebands.

params.label: Mod rate
params.behavior: Moves the modulator from rhythmic loudness motion into the audible range.

params.label: Depth
params.behavior: Sets how completely the modulator replaces constant gain.

params.label: Waveform
params.behavior: Selects the periodic AM waveform; discontinuous choices use the host's band-limited oscillator helper.

params.label: Polarity
params.behavior: Keeps the gain positive for tremolo or lets it invert for ring-modulator-like AM.

params.label: Start phase
params.behavior: Offsets both channel modulators around their cycle.

params.label: Stereo phase
params.behavior: Offsets left and right AM phase in opposite directions.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades between the incoming signal and AM result.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the final dry/wet result into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Chord Arpeggiator
entries.description: Traverses triads and seventh chords with inversion, direction, glide, swing, and a click-safe gate packed beside pitch.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the next chord tone is selected.

params.label: Chord
params.behavior: Chooses the interval table traversed by the arpeggiator.

params.label: Voicing
params.behavior: Rotates the chord or opens it across a wider register.

params.label: Direction
params.behavior: Changes how positions are mapped onto the voiced chord tones.

params.label: Transpose
params.behavior: Offsets the packed pitch in half-semitone steps before root-pitch input is added.

params.label: Gate width
params.behavior: Sets the active portion of each step; both edges are smoothed.

params.label: Glide
params.behavior: Interpolates toward the following chord tone near each step end.

params.label: Swing
params.behavior: Alternates step lengths while retaining the two-step duration.

entries.name: Euclidean Arpeggiator
entries.description: Places notes with an integer Euclidean predicate, advances scale pitch only across hits, and packs an edge-safe gate into output Y.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets the Euclidean grid rate.

params.label: Steps
params.behavior: Sets the number of grid positions in one rhythm cycle.

params.label: Pulses
params.behavior: Sets how many evenly distributed positions produce notes.

params.label: Rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the hit pattern without changing its spacing family.

params.label: Scale
params.behavior: Maps each hit ordinal onto a pitch collection, including 0.5-semitone quarter-tone steps.

params.label: Range
params.behavior: Sets how many scale octaves the hit sequence traverses.

params.label: Gate width
params.behavior: Sets how much of every active grid step remains high.

params.label: Glide
params.behavior: Moves toward the next Euclidean hit's scale pitch near the end of a note.

entries.name: Random-walk Arpeggiator
entries.description: Reconstructs a repeatable bounded pitch walk from the absolute step coordinate, with no mutable sequencer state.
entries.execution: Single-sample · at most 128 hashed walk increments

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the deterministic walk takes another step.

params.label: Walk length
params.behavior: Sets how many increments are reconstructed before a newly seeded walk begins.

params.label: Scale
params.behavior: Maps the wrapped walk degree onto a pitch collection, including 0.5-semitone quarter-tone steps.

params.label: Range
params.behavior: Bounds the walk before it wraps into the scale range.

params.label: Max stride
params.behavior: Sets the largest signed scale-degree change per step.

params.label: Seed
params.behavior: Selects a repeatable family of walk increments and restart degrees.

params.label: Gate width
params.behavior: Sets the active portion of every step with smoothed edges.

params.label: Glide
params.behavior: Interpolates toward the next reconstructed walk degree.

entries.name: Additive Drawbar Organ
entries.description: Sums nine editable rank lanes from organ_rank; every lane carries ratio, level, AM rate, and AM depth for GPU-parallel registration design.

params.label: Fundamental
params.behavior: Sets the fundamental beneath all external rank ratios.

params.label: Active ranks
params.behavior: Bounds how many rows of organ_rank are evaluated.

params.label: Timbre tilt
params.behavior: Tilts rank levels by their frequency ratio.

params.label: Chorale
params.behavior: Adds rank-dependent slow phase motion without history reads.

params.label: Rotor
params.behavior: Adds opposing analytic amplitude and phase motion across stereo.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Separates alternating drawbars and increases rotor stereo depth.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the energy-normalized registration into a soft ceiling.

params.label: Control depth
params.behavior: Routes the control input into timbre and chorale motion.

entries.name: Supersaw Unison
entries.description: Stacks up to nine phase-scattered, band-limited oscillators with symmetric detune, analytic drift, and stereo distribution.

params.label: Frequency
params.behavior: Sets the center pitch of the unison bank.

params.label: Voices
params.behavior: Sets how many symmetric oscillator lanes are summed.

params.label: Detune
params.behavior: Spreads voice pitch around the center in cents.

params.label: Stereo spread
params.behavior: Distributes unison lanes across equal-power stereo positions.

params.label: Drift rate
params.behavior: Sets the speed of per-voice analytic pitch drift.

params.label: Drift depth
params.behavior: Scales integrated sinusoidal pitch drift and its control input.

params.label: Waveform
params.behavior: Chooses the host band-limited waveform used by every lane.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the power-normalized unison sum into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Analytic Chirp Sweep
entries.description: Integrates a curved frequency trajectory exactly within each event, producing clean risers, dives, pings, and test-like sweeps.

params.label: Event rate
params.behavior: Sets how often a new sweep begins.

params.label: Start
params.behavior: Sets the frequency at event onset before pitch input.

params.label: End
params.behavior: Sets the frequency reached at the end of the active sweep.

params.label: Duration
params.behavior: Sets active sweep time, clamped below the repetition period.

params.label: Curve
params.behavior: Curves instantaneous frequency while retaining its analytic phase integral.

params.label: Tail
params.behavior: Applies a click-safe exponential amplitude contour within the sweep window.

params.label: Stereo phase
params.behavior: Offsets the harmonic detail in opposite directions without delaying history.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the completed chirp.

entries.name: Air Swoosh
entries.description: Sweeps a randomized bank of analytic partials through a raised-sine air envelope, with optional decorrelated hash hiss.
entries.execution: Single-sample · eight chirp lanes + bounded hiss

params.label: Event rate
params.behavior: Sets how often another air gesture begins.

params.label: Duration
params.behavior: Sets the active whoosh length below the event period.

params.label: Start center
params.behavior: Sets the initial center of the randomized partial cloud.

params.label: Sweep ratio
params.behavior: Multiplies every lane's frequency across the gesture.

params.label: Bandwidth
params.behavior: Spreads chirp lanes around the center frequency.

params.label: Hiss
params.behavior: Adds decorrelated, transient-windowed hash hiss and phase turbulence.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Spreads randomized lanes and hiss across stereo.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized air gesture into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Laser Woosh
entries.description: Fires a curved analytic chirp through bounded self-phase modulation for repeatable zaps, pews, dives, and ricochets.

params.label: Event rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the laser envelope and phase restart.

params.label: Start
params.behavior: Sets the laser's onset frequency before pitch input.

params.label: End
params.behavior: Sets the frequency at the end of the shot.

params.label: Duration
params.behavior: Sets active shot length below the repetition period.

params.label: Trajectory
params.behavior: Shapes the instantaneous-frequency path while phase remains integrated.

params.label: Phase warp
params.behavior: Adds bounded self-phase modulation and an overtone flash.

params.label: Stereo
params.behavior: Offsets phase warp and overtone detail across channels.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the completed shot into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Robot Voice
entries.description: Weights a phase-warped harmonic carrier with moving vowel peaks and smooth machine-rate articulation for intelligible metallic drones.

params.label: Fundamental
params.behavior: Sets harmonic spacing beneath the synthetic mouth.

params.label: Vowel scan
params.behavior: Moves three spectral peaks through a vowel trajectory.

params.label: Harmonics
params.behavior: Sets how many carrier partials can meet the formant peaks.

params.label: Mouth width
params.behavior: Sets the width of the synthetic formant regions.

params.label: Machine rate
params.behavior: Adds continuous periodic articulation without hard gain edges.

params.label: Metal
params.behavior: Raises inharmonic phase-warp sidebands around each formant-weighted partial.

params.label: Talk depth
params.behavior: Sets how strongly the control input moves the vowel scan.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the energy-normalized robot voice into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Analytic Plucked String
entries.description: Evaluates a finite damped string-mode series whose initial amplitudes follow pluck position and whose upper modes bend with stiffness.

params.label: Pluck rate
params.behavior: Sets how often all modes are excited from zero.

params.label: Fundamental
params.behavior: Sets the ideal-string fundamental before pitch input.

params.label: Modes
params.behavior: Bounds the number of damped string modes evaluated per sample.

params.label: Pluck position
params.behavior: Places spectral notches through the physical sin(nπp) excitation law.

params.label: Decay
params.behavior: Sets the low-mode exponential decay time.

params.label: Stiffness
params.behavior: Stretches upper modes progressively sharp for wire- and bar-like colors.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Offsets alternating modal phase in opposite stereo directions.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the energy-normalized pluck.

entries.name: Analytic Wave Terrain
entries.description: Drives a closed circular orbit through one of six procedural 2D height fields, turning geometric path changes into timbre changes.

params.label: Orbit pitch
params.behavior: Sets how often the path circles the terrain.

params.label: Orbit radius
params.behavior: Changes how much of the height field one waveform cycle traverses.

params.label: Center X
params.behavior: Moves the orbit horizontally through the procedural terrain.

params.label: Center Y
params.behavior: Moves the orbit vertically through the procedural terrain.

params.label: Terrain
params.behavior: Selects a bounded analytic 2D surface.

params.label: Warp
params.behavior: Increases domain deformation inside the chosen terrain.

params.label: Stereo orbit
params.behavior: Rotates the right-channel orbit and offsets both centers oppositely.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the terrain samples into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Fractal Recurrence
entries.description: Maps a periodic orbit through a clamped inversion recurrence, exposing brittle tones and deterministic pseudo-chaos without sample feedback.

params.label: Orbit pitch
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the seed orbit circles before iteration.

params.label: Seed
params.behavior: Moves the inversion offset through different attractor families.

params.label: Iterations
params.behavior: Sets the fixed maximum recurrence depth.

params.label: Readout fold
params.behavior: Scales the final bounded coordinates before sinusoidal readout.

params.label: Seed motion
params.behavior: Moves the recurrence offset with an analytic low-frequency orbit.

params.label: Chaos CV
params.behavior: Sets how strongly the control input changes the recurrence seed.

params.label: Stereo seed
params.behavior: Offsets the two channel recurrences in opposite directions.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the bounded recurrence readout.

entries.name: Procedural Snare
entries.description: Layers two decaying shell modes with differentiated deterministic noise and a short wire snap, all reconstructed from event age.

params.label: Hit rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the snare is struck.

params.label: Body pitch
params.behavior: Sets the lower pair of decaying tonal modes.

params.label: Body decay
params.behavior: Sets how long shell modes remain audible.

params.label: Wire decay
params.behavior: Sets the exponential tail of the noise layer.

params.label: Noise tone
params.behavior: Crossfades white hash noise toward a normalized first difference.

params.label: Snap
params.behavior: Adds a much shorter high-noise onset above the main wire tail.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Blends toward decorrelated left and right noise while the shell stays centered.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales shell and wires together into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Metallic Hi-hat
entries.description: Excites an eight-lane inharmonic sine alloy with a fast transient and variable open decay, avoiding raw square-wave alias spray.

params.label: Hit rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the metallic bank is excited.

params.label: Metal pitch
params.behavior: Sets the base beneath eight inharmonic ratios.

params.label: Closed decay
params.behavior: Sets the base amplitude decay before Open extends it.

params.label: Alloy
params.behavior: Moves the fixed ratio bank through deterministic inharmonic offsets.

params.label: Brightness
params.behavior: Tilts energy toward higher metallic lanes.

params.label: Open
params.behavior: Extends the modal decay toward an open-hat tail.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Distributes alternating metal modes across stereo.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the energy-normalized metal bank.

entries.name: Clap Burst
entries.description: Shapes decorrelated noise into one to four softened attacks plus a diffuse exponential tail for flams, crushed claps, and crowds.

params.label: Clap rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the entire burst cluster repeats.

params.label: Tone
params.behavior: Moves the noise from white toward differentiated high-frequency energy.

params.label: Burst spacing
params.behavior: Sets the time between successive hand-like attacks.

params.label: Bursts
params.behavior: Sets how many softened noise windows make the initial cluster.

params.label: Tail decay
params.behavior: Sets the exponential duration of the post-cluster noise.

params.label: Tail
params.behavior: Raises the diffuse noise behind and after the hand bursts.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Blends toward independently hashed left and right clap noise.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales burst cluster and tail into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: FOF Formant Voice
entries.description: Repeats exponentially damped formant sinusoids at the fundamental rate, separating perceived pitch from resonant vocal color.

params.label: Pulse pitch
params.behavior: Sets how often a new formant grain begins.

params.label: Formant
params.behavior: Sets the principal ringing frequency inside every pitch-synchronous grain.

params.label: Bandwidth
params.behavior: Sets exponential formant damping; higher values make shorter, wider-band grains.

params.label: Grain length
params.behavior: Sets the maximum raised-sine grain window below one pitch period.

params.label: Second formant
params.behavior: Adds a quieter formant at a ratio of the principal resonance.

params.label: Breath
params.behavior: Adds deterministic noise under the same click-safe grain window.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Offsets formant phase and breath seeds across stereo.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the formant-grain voice into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Full-wave Rectifier
entries.description: Folds negative waveform halves upward, optionally smoothing the cusp and subtracting the normalized-sine DC estimate.

params.label: Drive
params.behavior: Scales the signal before its negative half is folded upward.

params.label: Bias
params.behavior: Offsets the fold point and changes the balance of even harmonics.

params.label: DC trim
params.behavior: Subtracts up to 2/π, the mean of a unit full-wave-rectified sine.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades between the input and centered rectifier output.

params.label: Cusp softness
params.behavior: Rounds the zero-crossing cusp to reduce the brightest generated harmonics.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the dry/wet result into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Mid / Side Width
entries.description: Encodes stereo into center and difference components, scales and rotates that plane, then decodes it with peak compensation.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Scales the difference channel before stereo decoding.

params.label: Mid gain
params.behavior: Scales material common to both channels.

params.label: Side gain
params.behavior: Scales channel-difference material before Width.

params.label: M/S rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the mid/side coordinate plane by up to 45 degrees.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades between the original stereo and decoded matrix result.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the final matrix output after peak compensation.

entries.name: Cyclic Fractal Noise
entries.description: Loops a 3D seed orbit through a rotated, trigonometric octave field for coherent textures ranging from air to liquid machinery.

params.label: Orbit rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the closed seed path is traversed.

params.label: Octaves
params.behavior: Bounds the number of rotated procedural field layers.

params.label: Lacunarity
params.behavior: Scales coordinates between fractal octaves.

params.label: Warp
params.behavior: Feeds trigonometric cross-components back into the next octave coordinate.

params.label: Color
params.behavior: Changes field phase offsets and the balance of its three readout axes.

params.label: Weather CV
params.behavior: Moves the seed orbit and color from the control input.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Blends the left field axis toward an independently structured right axis.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized procedural field into a soft ceiling.

entries.name: Bitmask Rhythm
entries.description: Reads a 16-bit pattern and accent word on a swung step grid, producing a deterministic click-safe control gate.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the mask reader advances.

params.label: Steps
params.behavior: Sets how many low-order bits form the repeating cycle.

params.label: Gate mask
params.behavior: Stores the 16 on/off gate positions as an exactly representable integer.

params.label: Rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the bit reader without rewriting the mask.

params.label: Gate width
params.behavior: Sets active gate duration with a short smoothed attack and release.

params.label: Accent mask
params.behavior: Stores a second 16-bit word that marks emphasized active steps.

params.label: Accent depth
params.behavior: Lowers unaccented gate levels while accented bits remain at one.

params.label: Swing
params.behavior: Alternates bit-step lengths while preserving each two-step duration.

entries.name: Morph Crossfade
entries.description: Morphs between two stereo signals with equal-power gains, an optional control input, and adjustable motion around the center.

params.label: Morph
params.behavior: Moves continuously between the two inputs with equal-power gains.

params.label: CV depth
params.behavior: Sets how strongly the morph control moves the crossfade position and can reverse its direction.

params.label: Response
params.behavior: Reshapes crossfade travel while preserving both endpoints and the exact center.

params.label: A gain
params.behavior: Trims the first input before its equal-power gain is applied.

params.label: B gain
params.behavior: Trims the second input before its equal-power gain is applied.

params.label: Center trim
params.behavior: Reduces the center overlap when both inputs contain strongly correlated material.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the completed morph after its gain law.

entries.name: Harmonic Exciter
entries.description: Adds controlled second-, third-, and fifth-order color with a zero-safe asymmetric branch and a bounded output ceiling.

params.label: Drive
params.behavior: Raises the signal into the harmonic polynomial while its domain remains bounded.

params.label: Third harmonic
params.behavior: Adds a lower odd harmonic that thickens fundamentals without a hard corner.

params.label: Fifth harmonic
params.behavior: Adds a quieter upper odd harmonic for presence and edge.

params.label: Even color
params.behavior: Adds a zero-referenced second-order branch for tube-like asymmetry.

params.label: Drive CV
params.behavior: Lets a control signal push the excitation amount without changing the dry level.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the original signal to the generated harmonic color.

params.label: Ceiling
params.behavior: Sets the smooth hyperbolic ceiling that keeps bright settings bounded.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the dry/wet result after excitation.

entries.name: CV Curve Mapper
entries.description: Scales, offsets, bends, inverts, and limits a control signal so one modulation source can suit very different destinations.
entries.execution: Single-sample · signed or unipolar power curve

params.label: Gain
params.behavior: Scales the incoming control; negative values invert its direction.

params.label: Offset
params.behavior: Moves the control range before curve shaping.

params.label: Curve
params.behavior: Changes whether small or large input movements dominate the output.

params.label: Polarity
params.behavior: Chooses signed shaping around zero or a 0–1 control range.

params.label: Limit
params.behavior: Clamps the shaped control to a predictable destination-safe range.

params.label: Shape mix
params.behavior: Blends between the scaled linear control and its curved version.

entries.name: Mirror Fold Sequencer
entries.description: Treats step number as a shader coordinate, then repeatedly tiles and mirrors that coordinate before reading pitch from the folded position.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly time advances from one folded coordinate to the next.

params.label: Pattern length
params.behavior: Sets how many source coordinates exist before the domain repeats.

params.label: Fold passes
params.behavior: Repeats the tile-and-mirror operation, creating nested and self-similar note orderings.

params.label: Symmetry
params.behavior: Sets how many mirrored subdomains are created during every fold pass.

params.label: Fold offset
params.behavior: Moves the fold origins so the same symmetry produces a different traversal.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Quantizes geometric positions to a musical pitch lattice; Quarter-tone uses 24 equal divisions per octave.

params.label: Pitch span
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the geometric field can traverse.

params.label: Gate width
params.behavior: Sets how much of each folded coordinate remains audible with smoothed edges.

entries.name: SDF Shape Sequencer
entries.description: Sweeps a line through a repeated signed shape field; each boundary crossing becomes a gate and each shape cell chooses a pitch.

params.label: Cell rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the scan line crosses each geometric cell.

params.label: Shape
params.behavior: Changes the signed-distance formula and therefore the number and placement of crossings.

params.label: Shape extent
params.behavior: Maps the complete range to a useful extent for the selected shape, changing when the scan crosses its boundary.

params.label: Boundary band
params.behavior: Sets the audible thickness around the zero-distance contour.

params.label: Rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the scan path relative to the shape before measuring distance.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Quantizes geometric positions to a musical pitch lattice; Quarter-tone uses 24 equal divisions per octave.

params.label: Pitch span
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the geometric field can traverse.

params.label: Cell seed
params.behavior: Chooses repeatable scan heights and pitch identities for the shape cells.

entries.name: Polar Kaleidoscope
entries.description: Wraps a circular step path into angular wedges and reflects every wedge, producing radial, palindromic pitch order.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the point moves around the musical circle.

params.label: Orbit steps
params.behavior: Sets how many angular samples complete the repeating orbit.

params.label: Mirror sectors
params.behavior: Divides the circle into reflected angular sectors.

params.label: Angular stride
params.behavior: Changes which angular point follows the current one, forming polygonal and star-like traversals.

params.label: Rotation
params.behavior: Moves the wedge seams through the orbit and changes the mirrored note order.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Quantizes geometric positions to a musical pitch lattice; Quarter-tone uses 24 equal divisions per octave.

params.label: Pitch span
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the geometric field can traverse.

params.label: Gate width
params.behavior: Sets how long each angular sample remains audible.

entries.name: Voronoi Cell Sequencer
entries.description: Finds the closest jittered time-cell site and its runner-up; sites or the F2−F1 border ridge become irregular but deterministic musical events.

params.label: Cell rate
params.behavior: Sets the average density of Voronoi sites along musical time.

params.label: Site jitter
params.behavior: Moves each site away from the center of its cell, creating unequal event spacing.

params.label: Trigger feature
params.behavior: Chooses whether gates occur near nearest sites or where two cells are equally close.

params.label: Feature width
params.behavior: Sets the distance around each site or border that produces a gate.

params.label: Cell seed
params.behavior: Chooses a repeatable arrangement of sites and pitch identities.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Quantizes geometric positions to a musical pitch lattice; Quarter-tone uses 24 equal divisions per octave.

params.label: Pitch span
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the geometric field can traverse.

params.label: Pitch order
params.behavior: Morphs pitch choice from sequential cell order toward a deterministic per-feature shuffle.

entries.name: Truchet Path Sequencer
entries.description: Moves a scan point through hashed Truchet tiles; distance to the paired quarter-circle arcs opens gates along a repeatable curved path.
entries.execution: Single-sample · hashed tile orientation + arc SDF

params.label: Tile rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the scan point crosses each tile.

params.label: Tile strip
params.behavior: Sets how many independently oriented tiles form the repeating path.

params.label: Path height
params.behavior: Moves the scan line vertically through the quarter-circle paths.

params.label: Path wander
params.behavior: Moves the scan height slowly across the strip so different arcs become active.

params.label: Arc width
params.behavior: Sets the audible thickness around each Truchet arc.

params.label: Tile seed
params.behavior: Chooses tile orientations and their repeatable pitch identities.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Quantizes geometric positions to a musical pitch lattice; Quarter-tone uses 24 equal divisions per octave.

params.label: Pitch span
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the geometric field can traverse.

entries.name: KIFS Fold Sequencer
entries.description: Applies a bounded kaleidoscopic iterated-function fold to each point on a circular step path, turning self-similar regions into notes and rests.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the circular seed path advances.

params.label: Orbit points
params.behavior: Sets how many seed points are sampled before the fractal path repeats.

params.label: Fold iterations
params.behavior: Sets the bounded number of absolute, rotation, scale, and offset operations.

params.label: Fold scale
params.behavior: Scales the point on every iteration and changes the density of nested regions.

params.label: Fold angle
params.behavior: Rotates every reflected domain before the next iteration.

params.label: Fold offset
params.behavior: Translates each recursive domain and changes its self-similar islands.

params.label: Region fill
params.behavior: Sets which folded regions produce audible events.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Quantizes geometric positions to a musical pitch lattice; Quarter-tone uses 24 equal divisions per octave.

entries.name: Interference Lattice
entries.description: Sums rotated plane waves along a two-dimensional orbit, then thresholds their interference field into quasi-periodic gates and pitches.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the orbit samples the interference field.

params.label: Orbit samples
params.behavior: Sets how many points are read before the orbit repeats.

params.label: Wave axes
params.behavior: Sets how many evenly rotated plane waves contribute to the field.

params.label: Spatial frequency
params.behavior: Sets the spacing of the virtual lines whose overlaps form rhythmic beats.

params.label: Lattice rotation
params.behavior: Rotates every interference axis around the sampled orbit.

params.label: Gate threshold
params.behavior: Keeps only field values above the chosen interference brightness.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Quantizes geometric positions to a musical pitch lattice; Quarter-tone uses 24 equal divisions per octave.

params.label: Pitch span
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the geometric field can traverse.

entries.name: Phase Plane
entries.description: Generates a continuous two-dimensional trajectory from absolute sample time so later geometry modules can be connected as coordinate processors.

params.label: Orbit rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the point completes its X-axis cycle.

params.label: Y/X ratio
params.behavior: Sets the frequency ratio between the two coordinate axes.

params.label: Y phase
params.behavior: Offsets Y relative to X, changing whether the path is a line, ellipse, or crossed orbit.

params.label: X radius
params.behavior: Scales horizontal travel through every connected field.

params.label: Y radius
params.behavior: Scales vertical travel through every connected field.

params.label: X center
params.behavior: Moves the orbit across the field without changing its shape.

params.label: Y center
params.behavior: Moves the orbit vertically through the field.

params.label: Phase CV depth
params.behavior: Offsets orbit phase from the input without pretending an arbitrary control signal can be integrated as stateless rate modulation.

entries.name: Tile + Mirror
entries.description: Repeats incoming X/Y coordinates into local cells and optionally mirrors each axis, turning one trajectory into a tiled or palindromic domain.

params.label: Repeat X
params.behavior: Sets horizontal cell density and therefore horizontal event repetition.

params.label: Repeat Y
params.behavior: Sets vertical cell density independently from X.

params.label: Domain rotation
params.behavior: Mixes X and Y clocks before tiling, changing their recurrence relationship.

params.label: Input scale
params.behavior: Scales the incoming trajectory before it enters the repeated grid.

params.label: Offset X
params.behavior: Moves horizontal cell seams through the trajectory.

params.label: Offset Y
params.behavior: Moves vertical cell seams through the trajectory.

params.label: Mirror X
params.behavior: Forward resets X at each tile seam; Mirrored reflects alternate travel into a continuous palindromic coordinate.

params.label: Mirror Y
params.behavior: Forward resets Y at each tile seam; Mirrored reflects alternate travel into a continuous palindromic coordinate.

entries.name: Polar Fold
entries.description: Converts X/Y into radius and angle, then repeats and reflects the angular domain like a kaleidoscope while radial twist couples distance to timing.

params.label: Sectors
params.behavior: Sets how many angular copies surround the origin.

params.label: Rotation
params.behavior: Moves the symmetry seams through the input path.

params.label: Radial twist
params.behavior: Adds radius to angular phase, converting rings into spiral-like time structures.

params.label: Radius gain
params.behavior: Scales the continuous radius output.

params.label: Radius offset
params.behavior: Moves the radius control range without changing angular folding.

params.label: Angle gain
params.behavior: Scales the folded-angle control output.

params.label: Angle mirror
params.behavior: Repeated resets at sector seams; Reflected reverses alternate sectors so neighboring angular travel meets continuously.

params.label: Radius fold
params.behavior: Morphs radius into repeating mirrored bands before output.

entries.name: SDF Pattern
entries.description: Measures incoming coordinates against a repeated analytic shape and exposes both its signed field and a softly edged contour gate.

params.label: Shape
params.behavior: Selects the signed-distance formula and its pattern of contour crossings.

params.label: Shape extent
params.behavior: Maps the full control range to a useful extent for the selected shape, so its contour remains inside the repeated cell.

params.label: Repeat X
params.behavior: Repeats the shape horizontally before measuring distance.

params.label: Repeat Y
params.behavior: Repeats the shape vertically.

params.label: Shape rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the incoming path relative to every repeated shape.

params.label: Contour band
params.behavior: Sets how far from the shape boundary the gate remains active.

params.label: Edge softness
params.behavior: Smooths contour transitions explicitly; compute shaders cannot use fragment-stage fwidth derivatives.

params.label: Gate polarity
params.behavior: Chooses the contour itself or its surrounding negative space as the event field.

entries.name: SDF Logic
entries.description: Combines two distance streams with union, intersection, subtraction, or XOR-like logic; a third control morphs toward a related operation.

params.label: Operation
params.behavior: Selects the signed-distance boolean used as the primary field.

params.label: Smooth union
params.behavior: Rounds the union and related morph target instead of switching at a sharp minimum.

params.label: Gate contour
params.behavior: Moves only the gate-extraction contour through the field; the continuous field output is unchanged.

params.label: Gate width
params.behavior: Sets the audible band around the combined distance contour.

params.label: Distance A gain
params.behavior: Rescales the first field before boolean composition.

params.label: Distance B gain
params.behavior: Rescales the second field independently.

params.label: Field output bias
params.behavior: Offsets the continuous field output itself, which also moves its gate contour unless Gate contour compensates.

params.label: Logic morph
params.behavior: Crossfades toward a paired distance operation; the morph input shifts this value by half range.

entries.name: Interference Field
entries.description: Sums evenly rotated plane waves at incoming X/Y coordinates and exposes their continuous interference brightness plus a thresholded event field.

params.label: Wave axes
params.behavior: Sets rotational symmetry by changing how many plane waves meet.

params.label: Spatial frequency
params.behavior: Sets virtual stripe spacing and event density.

params.label: Field rotation
params.behavior: Changes which mixture of X and Y motion crosses each wave.

params.label: Field phase
params.behavior: Moves all interference bands without moving the incoming trajectory.

params.label: Gate threshold
params.behavior: Selects how much constructive interference is needed for an event.

params.label: Gate softness
params.behavior: Smooths the threshold into a usable control envelope.

params.label: Field gain
params.behavior: Scales continuous field output around zero.

params.label: Field bias
params.behavior: Offsets continuous field output after normalization.

entries.name: Voronoi Events
entries.description: Searches a fixed 3×3 neighborhood around incoming coordinates; the nearest-cell identity becomes held CV while sites or the local F2−F1 ridge become events.

params.label: Cell scale
params.behavior: Sets how many cells the incoming path can cross.

params.label: Site jitter
params.behavior: Moves feature sites away from their cell centers.

params.label: Event feature
params.behavior: Chooses nearest-site distance or the F2−F1 ridge as the gate field.

params.label: Feature width
params.behavior: Maps the full knob to a useful distance range for sites or borders, whose natural scales differ.

params.label: Diagram seed
params.behavior: Chooses deterministic feature positions and held cell identities.

params.label: Motion X
params.behavior: Maps the motion input into horizontal travel through the cells.

params.label: Motion Y
params.behavior: Maps the same motion input into an independent vertical drift.

params.label: Cell CV spread
params.behavior: Scales the held random value associated with the nearest cell.

entries.name: Truchet Router
entries.description: Measures incoming coordinates against paired circular arcs in deterministic Truchet tiles; arc proximity becomes a gate, with a short seam fade before tile identity changes.
entries.execution: Single-sample · cell hash + two arc distances

params.label: Tile scale
params.behavior: Sets how many arc tiles the trajectory crosses.

params.label: Arc radius
params.behavior: Changes each pair of corner arcs; 0.5 meets neighboring tiles at their edge midpoints.

params.label: Arc width
params.behavior: Sets the active ribbon around each pair of tile arcs.

params.label: Orientation density
params.behavior: Biases the deterministic tile orientations and therefore global connectivity.

params.label: Tile seed
params.behavior: Chooses a repeatable tiled-arc layout.

params.label: Domain rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the input trajectory through the tile grid.

params.label: Turn CV depth
params.behavior: Lets the turn input rotate the entire path traversal.

params.label: Tile CV spread
params.behavior: Scales the stable value emitted for each tile orientation and identity.

entries.name: Shepard / Risset Spiral
entries.description: Layers octave-related oscillators under a sliding cosine envelope so the pitch appears to rise or fall continuously without leaving its register.

params.label: Center pitch
params.behavior: Sets the log-frequency center around which octave layers fade in and out.

params.label: Gliss rate
params.behavior: Sets the direction and speed of the endlessly wrapping octave glide; zero holds one spiral position.

params.label: Octave layers
params.behavior: Raises the number of octave-related voices available to hide each wrap.

params.label: Octave focus
params.behavior: Shapes the cosine amplitude window across the stacked octaves.

params.label: Harmonic color
params.behavior: Adds a Nyquist-faded second harmonic without breaking octave equivalence.

params.label: Stereo spiral
params.behavior: Places neighboring octave layers at different deterministic stereo positions.

params.label: Image rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the stereo positions slowly while the pitch spiral moves independently.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the energy-normalized spiral into a soft output ceiling.

entries.name: Procedural Bird Flock
entries.description: Schedules deterministic clusters of short analytic chirps, trills, and airy calls across independently offset stereo positions.

params.label: Cluster rate
params.behavior: Sets how often another bounded flock cluster begins.

params.label: Birds
params.behavior: Raises the number of independently timed chirp lanes evaluated per sample.

params.label: Call center
params.behavior: Sets the central frequency around which deterministic calls are distributed.

params.label: Pitch range
params.behavior: Widens the seeded start pitches and within-call chirp bends.

params.label: Call length
params.behavior: Sets the requested call duration, safely shortened when clusters overlap.

params.label: Trill rate
params.behavior: Sets the phase flutter within every chirp.

params.label: Flock width
params.behavior: Scales each bird's deterministic equal-power stereo position.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the activity-normalized flock into a soft output ceiling.

entries.name: Thunder / Impact Cell
entries.description: Combines an immediate crack, an analytically falling resonant body, and several deterministic low-rate noise bands into a repeating impact cell.
entries.execution: Single-sample · bounded click, body, and rumble layers

params.label: Impact rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the deterministic event cell restarts.

params.label: Body pitch
params.behavior: Sets the resting resonance beneath the initial pitch fall.

params.label: Rumble decay
params.behavior: Sets the exponential tail of the low body and noise rumble.

params.label: Body drop
params.behavior: Raises the impact's starting resonance before it falls analytically toward the body pitch.

params.label: Crack
params.behavior: Scales the fast broadband click and its short high resonant edge.

params.label: Rumble
params.behavior: Scales three decorrelated low-rate noise bands beneath the impact body.

params.label: Storm width
params.behavior: Moves each event to a deterministic stereo position and decorrelates its rumble.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized multi-timescale event into a soft output ceiling.

entries.name: Simple Delay
entries.description: Reads fractional positions from persistent signal history to make decaying echoes whose taps can alternate across stereo.

params.label: Time
params.behavior: Sets the spacing between taps; at the maximum, six taps extend across twelve seconds of history.

params.label: Taps
params.behavior: Adds later history reads without introducing a recursive feedback loop.

params.label: Decay
params.behavior: Reduces each successive tap, controlling how far the echo train appears to recede.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades the current signal with the normalized history-tap sum.

params.label: Stereo spread
params.behavior: Alternately pans successive taps so even a mono source opens into stereo.

params.label: Smear
params.behavior: Averages neighboring history samples, slightly softening bright echo edges.

params.label: Spacing
params.behavior: Warps the intermediate tap positions while keeping the first and final delay anchors fixed.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the complete dry/wet result before it reaches the next post effect.

entries.name: Convolution Reverb
entries.description: Builds a deterministic stereo reflection field from scattered reads of the persistent dry history.

params.label: Size
params.behavior: Spreads the reflection field from a compact room to a twelve-second response.

params.label: Decay (RT60)
params.behavior: Sets the time for reflection amplitude to fall by 60 dB; pre-delay shifts the room later without changing this decay rate.

params.label: Density
params.behavior: Raises the number of deterministic reflection points summed for every sample.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the incoming chain to the scattered reflection field.

params.label: Pre-delay
params.behavior: Inserts up to 400 milliseconds between the direct event and the first reflection.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Distributes reflection taps asymmetrically between the stereo channels.

params.label: Softness
params.behavior: Blends each reflection with its next-older sample to soften the room.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the complete dry/room result before the next post effect.

entries.name: Recombobulator
entries.execution: History pass · crossfaded moving tap field
entries.description: Continuously replaces a bank of signed, folded history reads with a new deterministic routing pattern.

params.label: Memory
params.behavior: Sets how far backward the moving read heads may reach, up to twelve seconds.

params.label: Heads
params.behavior: Adds simultaneous signed fragments before energy normalization.

params.label: Mutation
params.behavior: Sets how often a new deterministic tap map replaces the current one.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the incoming chain to the moving history collage.

params.label: Scatter
params.behavior: Moves head positions from an ordered spacing toward seeded random locations.

params.label: Fold
params.behavior: Morphs the fragment sum from soft saturation into repeated sine folding.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Controls channel swaps and independent pan offsets for the history heads.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the complete dry/recombined result before the next post effect.

entries.name: Sliding-DFT Resynth
entries.description: Measures a short causal spectrum at every sample and rebuilds its energy with shifted, phase-scattered oscillator bins.

params.label: Window
params.behavior: Sets the causal analysis span; the 64-sample minimum keeps every exposed positive-frequency bin available.

params.label: Bins
params.behavior: Raises the number of measured and resynthesized frequency bands.

params.label: Bin shift
params.behavior: Moves measured magnitudes onto lower or higher oscillator-bin frequencies.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the incoming chain to the rebuilt oscillator bank.

params.label: Phase scatter
params.behavior: Adds a deterministic phase offset to each resynthesis bin.

params.label: Spectral tilt
params.behavior: Weights high measured bins more strongly or more weakly during reconstruction.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Applies opposing fractions of each bin's phase scatter to the stereo channels.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the complete dry/resynthesized result before the next post effect.

entries.name: Flanger
entries.execution: History pass · stereo modulated fractional read
entries.description: Adds a very short, smoothly moving feed-forward delay to the dry signal for a swept comb-filter jet without recursive feedback.

params.label: Base delay
params.behavior: Sets the shortest delay around which the moving comb pattern forms.

params.label: Sweep depth
params.behavior: Expands the delay excursion while every read remains inside the persistent history buffer.

params.label: Sweep rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the fractional delay moves through its comb positions.

params.label: Wet amount
params.behavior: Raises the moving feed-forward tap against the direct signal.

params.label: Stereo phase
params.behavior: Offsets the left and right delay orbits to widen the sweep.

params.label: Tap polarity
params.behavior: Moves between inverted and normal delayed taps, changing where the comb peaks and nulls land.

params.label: Tap softness
params.behavior: Averages neighboring history samples to restrain sharp high-frequency motion.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the bounded flanged result before the next post effect.

entries.name: Chorus
entries.description: Averages several gently detuned fractional-delay voices with independent stereo phases to create a broad ensemble.

params.label: Base delay
params.behavior: Sets the common delay around which the ensemble voices drift.

params.label: Detune depth
params.behavior: Sets each voice's delay excursion and therefore its audible pitch movement; zero freezes the delayed voices.

params.label: Motion rate
params.behavior: Sets the central orbit rate shared by the chorus voices.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades into the normalized bank of moving delay voices.

params.label: Voices
params.behavior: Raises the number of independently phased history reads from three to six.

params.label: Stereo spread
params.behavior: Separates each voice's left and right modulation phase.

params.label: Rate drift
params.behavior: Offsets the voice rates slightly so their delay orbits continually re-form.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the bounded dry/ensemble result before the next post effect.

entries.name: Doppler Sweep
entries.execution: History pass · bounded moving propagation read
entries.description: Moves a causal fractional-delay read toward and away from the listener so pitch bends emerge from changing propagation time.

params.label: Center distance
params.behavior: Sets the middle propagation delay of the simulated pass.

params.label: Travel
params.behavior: Sets how far the read head travels around the center delay.

params.label: Sweep rate
params.behavior: Sets the speed of the delay motion and resulting pitch bend.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the direct signal to the moving propagation read.

params.label: Motion curve
params.behavior: Warps the smooth orbit to redistribute acceleration across the pass.

params.label: Stereo offset
params.behavior: Offsets the two channel trajectories for a wider moving image.

params.label: Distance loss
params.behavior: Attenuates longer delay positions so the source appears to move farther away.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the bounded Doppler result before the next post effect.

entries.name: FFT Robotizer
entries.execution: History pass · bounded sliding DFT phase replacement
entries.description: Keeps short-window spectral magnitudes but replaces analyzed phase with a fixed quantized phase map for a rigid robotic resynthesis.

params.label: Window
params.behavior: Sets the causal DFT span; the 64-sample minimum keeps all 24 exposed magnitude bins active.

params.label: Bins
params.behavior: Raises the number of magnitude bands rebuilt by the robotic oscillator bank.

params.label: Phase states
params.behavior: Quantizes the deterministic per-bin phase map into one to sixteen fixed states.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the incoming chain to magnitude-only phase-replaced resynthesis.

params.label: Pitch ratio
params.behavior: Moves measured magnitude bins onto lower or higher oscillator frequencies.

params.label: Spectral tilt
params.behavior: Changes the balance between low and high robotic bands.

params.label: Stereo phase
params.behavior: Applies opposing portions of the fixed phase map to the stereo channels.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the bounded robotic result before the next post effect.

entries.name: Spectral Gate
entries.execution: History pass · bounded sliding DFT threshold mask
entries.description: Measures a causal short-window spectrum, attenuates bins below a soft threshold, and resynthesizes the surviving phase-coherent bands.

params.label: Window
params.behavior: Sets the causal DFT span; the 64-sample minimum keeps all 24 exposed gate bins active.

params.label: Bins
params.behavior: Raises the number of independently gated frequency bands.

params.label: Threshold
params.behavior: Sets the magnitude a bin must approach before it opens.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the incoming chain to the masked spectral reconstruction.

params.label: Soft knee
params.behavior: Widens the transition around the threshold to reduce chatter.

params.label: Reduction
params.behavior: Sets how strongly bins below the threshold are attenuated.

params.label: Mask tilt
params.behavior: Weights reconstructed bands while retaining bounded overall energy.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the bounded gated result before the next post effect.

entries.name: FIR Low-pass
entries.execution: History pass · 7–31 FIR taps · fixed 15-sample alignment
entries.description: Applies a short causal windowed-sinc low-pass inside a fixed 31-sample span. Every kernel and the dry comparison share the same 15-sample latency, so changing tap count does not move the signal in time.

params.label: Kernel cutoff
params.behavior: Moves the short FIR kernel's broad transition. A 31-tap audio-rate kernel does not represent sub-bass cutoff values precisely.

params.label: Taps
params.behavior: Sets the odd active kernel length inside a fixed 31-sample span; latency remains 15 samples at every setting.

params.label: Hann window
params.behavior: Morphs the sinc kernel from a narrow rectangular window toward a Hann window with lower spectral ringing.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Moves from the time-aligned input to the filtered signal without introducing a parallel-path phase mismatch.

params.label: Stereo cutoff
params.behavior: Moves the left and right cutoff in opposite directions by up to one octave.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the filtered result through the shared soft output ceiling.

entries.name: FIR High-pass
entries.execution: History pass · aligned subtraction · 7–31 taps · fixed latency
entries.description: Subtracts a short windowed-sinc low-pass from the input delayed by 15 samples. The active kernel stays centered in a fixed span, preserving both the high-pass subtraction and live tap-count alignment.

params.label: Kernel cutoff
params.behavior: Moves the short FIR kernel's broad low-cut transition; the range begins where a 31-tap audio-rate kernel responds meaningfully.

params.label: Taps
params.behavior: Sets the odd active kernel length while its center and the dry path remain fixed at 15 samples of latency.

params.label: Hann window
params.behavior: Trades a narrower raw transition for lower stop-band ringing by tapering the sinc kernel.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Moves from the center-delayed input to the high-frequency remainder.

params.label: Stereo cutoff
params.behavior: Offsets the two channel cutoffs in opposite directions for frequency-dependent width.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the high-pass result through the shared soft output ceiling.

entries.name: FIR Band-pass
entries.execution: History pass · two aligned FIR sums · 7–31 taps · fixed latency
entries.description: Subtracts two short, equally aligned windowed-sinc low-passes. Both kernels stay centered at the same fixed 15-sample position so the selected broad frequency band and live tap changes remain aligned.

params.label: Lower kernel cutoff
params.behavior: Moves the lower broad transition of the surviving band.

params.label: Upper kernel cutoff
params.behavior: Moves the upper broad transition; the shader safely orders crossed cutoff controls.

params.label: Taps
params.behavior: Sets the shared odd active length of both kernels inside their fixed 31-sample span.

params.label: Hann window
params.behavior: Tapers both sinc kernels equally so their subtraction remains aligned.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Moves from the center-delayed input to the isolated frequency band.

params.label: Stereo cutoff
params.behavior: Moves both band edges oppositely across the left and right channels.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the isolated band through the shared soft output ceiling.

entries.name: Sample-rate Reducer
entries.description: Reads one earlier sample for each reduced-rate cell, optionally interpolating causally between adjacent held values; unlike bit crushing, this changes time resolution.

params.label: Sample rate
params.behavior: Sets how frequently the effect captures a new input value.

params.label: Interpolation
params.behavior: Moves from zero-order sample holding toward a one-cell-late smooth interpolation between captured values.

params.label: Capture phase
params.behavior: Moves the capture boundaries through the incoming waveform without reading future samples.

params.label: Stereo phase
params.behavior: Offsets the right-channel capture grid by up to half a reduced-rate cell.

params.label: Bit depth
params.behavior: Optionally adds amplitude quantization; zero or one leaves amplitude untouched.

params.label: Dither
params.behavior: Adds deterministic cell-rate dither before optional amplitude quantization.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the current input to the held or interpolated result.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the reduced-rate result through the shared soft output ceiling.

entries.name: Vibrato
entries.execution: History pass · continuously moving fractional read
entries.description: Moves a causal fractional-delay read smoothly around the present, turning delay motion into a controlled periodic pitch bend.

params.label: Rate
params.behavior: Sets how many complete pitch-bend cycles occur each second.

params.label: Pitch depth
params.behavior: Sets the approximate peak pitch excursion; one hundred cents is one semitone.

params.label: Base delay
params.behavior: Sets the causal look-back position; the shader raises it automatically when a wide, slow bend needs more travel.

params.label: Mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the direct signal to the moving read; intermediate values also create a light chorus.

params.label: Stereo phase
params.behavior: Offsets the right-channel vibrato cycle by up to one quarter turn.

params.label: Wave shape
params.behavior: Morphs the smooth sinusoidal bend toward a more constant-speed triangular rise and fall.

params.label: Softness
params.behavior: Averages neighboring history samples to gently restrain bright interpolation edges.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the bounded vibrato result before the next post effect.

entries.name: Trigger / Impulse
entries.description: Marks a deterministic sample address with a pulse. A width of one sample is a unit impulse; wider defaults make the event easier to audition as a gate.

params.label: Event rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the sample-addressed event repeats.

params.label: Width
params.behavior: Sets the number of active samples; one produces the exact unit impulse.

params.label: Edge smoothing
params.behavior: Rounds wider pulse edges while leaving a one-sample impulse intact.

params.label: Clock phase
params.behavior: Moves the event address within its repeating period.

params.label: Accent cycle
params.behavior: Sets how many events occur between emphasized impulses.

params.label: Accent
params.behavior: Raises the accent and slightly lowers the intervening events.

params.label: Alternating polarity
params.behavior: Optionally inverts every other event for excitation experiments.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the final trigger value.

entries.name: Segment ADSR
