entries.description: Evaluates a repeating attack, decay, sustain, and release contour directly from note-local sample time, with no hidden envelope state.

params.label: Note rate
params.behavior: Sets the duration of the repeating analytic note.

params.label: Gate length
params.behavior: Places note-off within each cycle so the release segment has a known start time.

params.label: Attack
params.behavior: Sets the time from zero to the envelope peak.

params.label: Decay
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the peak approaches the sustain level.

params.label: Sustain
params.behavior: Sets the held level after decay and before note-off.

params.label: Release
params.behavior: Sets the fall from the note-off level to zero; values longer than the remaining cycle are compressed to the next zero boundary.

params.label: Segment curve
params.behavior: Curves both the attack and release while preserving their endpoints.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the complete ADSR contour.

entries.name: Grain Window
entries.description: Generates a bounded periodic splice window whose endpoints reach zero before the next grain begins.

params.label: Grain rate
params.behavior: Sets how often a new analytic window begins.

params.label: Active duration
params.behavior: Sets how much of each period contains the window before returning to zero.

params.label: Shape
params.behavior: Selects the analytic window family.

params.label: Shape amount
params.behavior: Changes Hann or sine curvature, Gaussian width, or Tukey taper while keeping the splice endpoints at zero.

params.label: Skew
params.behavior: Warps grain phase so the window leans toward its attack or release.

params.label: Window phase
params.behavior: Offsets the window inside the repeating sample clock.

params.label: Window lobes
params.behavior: Introduces signed inner lobes while preserving zero at both splice endpoints.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the active window without changing its timing.

entries.name: Log Range Mapper
entries.description: Maps a normalized control across a positive range with even proportional or octave spacing.

params.label: Minimum
params.behavior: Sets one positive endpoint of the mapped range.

params.label: Maximum
params.behavior: Sets the other positive endpoint; endpoints are sorted safely in the shader.

params.label: Curve
params.behavior: Warps normalized travel before logarithmic interpolation.

params.label: Input range
params.behavior: Chooses how the incoming control is normalized.

params.label: Input gain
params.behavior: Scales the input before normalization and clamping.

params.label: Input offset
params.behavior: Offsets the input before normalization and clamping.

params.label: Direction
params.behavior: Reverses the direction of the logarithmic mapping.

params.label: Output scale
params.behavior: Scales the mapped physical value before output.

entries.name: Rounded-edge Oscillator
entries.description: Rounds a saw or square discontinuity geometrically, creating filter-like spectral motion without claiming to filter arbitrary audio.

params.label: Frequency
params.behavior: Sets the oscillator fundamental before pitch input and MIDI transposition.

params.label: Waveform
params.behavior: Selects which discontinuous waveform receives geometric edge rounding.

params.label: Roundness
params.behavior: Morphs a linear saw ramp toward a continuous rounded cycle, progressively reducing the reset discontinuity.

params.label: Roundness CV
params.behavior: Sets how strongly the first input moves edge roundness.

params.label: Stereo detune
params.behavior: Offsets left and right oscillator frequencies in opposite directions.

params.label: Drive
params.behavior: Pushes the rounded waveform into a soft ceiling.

params.label: Geometry mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the host's corrected oscillator to the ShaderToy-style rounded edge.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the stereo oscillator result.

entries.name: Partial Transfer Filter
entries.description: Builds its own harmonic bank, applies a low-pass magnitude curve, and gives every known partial an independently adjustable frequency-dependent phase color. It is not an arbitrary-audio filter.

params.label: Fundamental
params.behavior: Sets the harmonic-bank fundamental before pitch input and MIDI transposition.

params.label: Partials
params.behavior: Bounds how many harmonics receive the analytic transfer response.

params.label: Cutoff
params.behavior: Places the analytic low-pass corner across the known harmonic series.

params.label: Resonance
params.behavior: Raises a bounded Gaussian peak around the transfer cutoff.

params.label: Slope
params.behavior: Changes how quickly partial magnitudes fall above cutoff.

params.label: Partial phase color
params.behavior: Increases an independent frequency-dependent phase offset across the partial bank; it is not the exact phase response of the magnitude curve.

params.label: Cutoff CV
params.behavior: Sets how many cutoff octaves the first input can traverse.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized filtered harmonic bank.

entries.name: Gaussian Pair
entries.description: Transforms two patched uniform controls into a correlated pair of bell-shaped values using the stateless Box–Muller transform.

params.label: X mean
params.behavior: Offsets the first Gaussian output.

params.label: Y mean
params.behavior: Offsets the second Gaussian output.

params.label: Deviation
params.behavior: Sets the standard deviation of both outputs.

params.label: Correlation
params.behavior: Correlates the second result with the first while keeping bounded variance.

params.label: Pair rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the two-dimensional Gaussian result.

params.label: Safety range
params.behavior: Clamps rare distribution tails to a predictable patching range.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales both Gaussian outputs after clipping.

params.label: Uniform offset
params.behavior: Offsets both patched uniform coordinates before the transform.

entries.name: Clock Duck
entries.description: Choreographs gain from a known analytic clock or a patched duck envelope. It does not pretend to detect unexpected audio peaks.

params.label: Clock rate
params.behavior: Sets the internal deterministic duck cycle.

params.label: Depth
params.behavior: Sets how strongly the selected envelope lowers gain.

params.label: Floor gain
params.behavior: Sets the lowest gain reached at maximum ducking.

params.label: Duck attack
params.behavior: Sets how quickly attenuation reaches its maximum after the clock event.

params.label: Hold
params.behavior: Keeps maximum attenuation before recovery begins.

params.label: Recovery
params.behavior: Sets how long gain takes to recover after the hold.

params.label: External envelope
params.behavior: Crossfades from analytic clock ducking to the second input.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the ducked stereo result.

entries.name: Parallel Voice Bank
entries.description: Evaluates a bounded bank of independently pitched, drifting, and panned oscillator voices inside each output sample.

params.label: Center pitch
params.behavior: Sets the center frequency before pitch input and MIDI transposition.

params.label: Voices
params.behavior: Bounds how many voices are evaluated and normalized.

params.label: Waveform
params.behavior: Selects the waveform shared by the voice bank.

params.label: Interval spread
params.behavior: Spreads voices symmetrically in semitone intervals.

params.label: Fine detune
params.behavior: Adds continuous symmetric fine detuning around the interval structure.

params.label: Stereo width
params.behavior: Pans voices across the stereo field; spread input can move it further.

params.label: Pitch drift
params.behavior: Applies a phase-correct sinusoidal frequency drift independently to each voice.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the energy-normalized bank.

entries.name: Hex / Triangle Lattice
entries.description: Moves a trajectory through a 60-degree coordinate basis so crossings on three coupled axes become related gates and pitches.

params.label: Travel rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the trajectory crosses lattice cells.

params.label: Path length
params.behavior: Sets how many lattice positions form the repeating path.

params.label: Lattice
params.behavior: Changes how the same three axes are combined into a gate field.

params.label: Density
params.behavior: Sets the spatial frequency of the repeated lattice.

params.label: Rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the trajectory through all three axes together.

params.label: Crossing threshold
params.behavior: Raises the field level required to open a gate, moving from broad lattice regions toward isolated crossings.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Maps the geometric field onto a pitch collection, including quarter-tone steps.

params.label: Pitch span
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the generated pitch field can traverse.

entries.name: Log Spiral Events
entries.description: Converts polar angle and logarithmic radius into scale-invariant event bands whose timing changes as the orbit moves inward and outward.

params.label: Orbit rate
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the analytic point travels around and across the spiral.

params.label: Spiral arms
params.behavior: Repeats the logarithmic event field around the polar angle.

params.label: Log turns
params.behavior: Sets how strongly logarithmic radius rotates event phase.

params.label: Radial motion
params.behavior: Sets how often the trajectory moves inward and outward during an orbit.

params.label: Rotation
params.behavior: Offsets the complete logarithmic spiral field.

params.label: Event width
params.behavior: Sets the width of each softly edged spiral event.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Maps the geometric field onto a pitch collection, including quarter-tone steps.

params.label: Pitch span
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the generated pitch field can traverse.

entries.name: Domain-warp Time Field
entries.description: Builds two bounded octave fields, uses them to bend the input coordinate, and emits a related continuous control and event gate.

params.label: Octaves
params.behavior: Bounds how many spatial frequency layers each field evaluates.

params.label: Base frequency
params.behavior: Sets the first field frequency before octave multiplication.

params.label: Warp depth
params.behavior: Sets how far the first field pair displaces the second lookup.

params.label: Lacunarity
params.behavior: Sets the frequency ratio between successive field layers.

params.label: Octave gain
params.behavior: Sets how slowly upper-octave field amplitudes decay.

params.label: Field speed
params.behavior: Animates the domain without carrying hidden state.

params.label: Gate threshold
params.behavior: Chooses which warped-field values open the event output.

params.label: Gate softness
params.behavior: Widens the continuous transition around the gate threshold.

entries.name: Fractal Orbit-trap Events
entries.description: Runs a bounded inverse-and-fold recurrence per sample and turns the nearest orbit-trap approach into continuous control and sparse gates.

params.label: Iterations
params.behavior: Bounds the number of recurrence folds evaluated per output sample.

params.label: Input zoom
params.behavior: Scales the incoming coordinate before recurrence.

params.label: Rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the coordinate before orbit iteration.

params.label: Absolute fold
params.behavior: Morphs from an inverse recurrence into absolute-value KIFS folding.

params.label: Trap radius
params.behavior: Sets the radius whose closest approach is measured across the orbit.

params.label: Event width
params.behavior: Sets how close the orbit must approach the trap to open a gate.

params.label: Orbit seed
params.behavior: Selects a deterministic recurrence offset and orientation.

params.label: Field level
params.behavior: Scales the continuous trap-distance output without changing the gate.

entries.name: Analytic Glide Oscillator
entries.description: Repeats a finite exponential pitch glide, then continues at its exact ending phase and frequency during a hold segment; a short zero-edge window makes the stateless restart click-safe.
entries.execution: Single-sample · analytic phase integral · no history

params.label: Start frequency
params.behavior: Sets the frequency at the beginning of each finite glide before performance-note transposition.

params.label: Glide interval
params.behavior: Sets the ending pitch relative to the start in semitones; pitch changes exponentially in hertz and linearly in pitch space.

params.label: Glide time
params.behavior: Sets the finite interval over which instantaneous frequency moves from the start to the end.

params.label: End hold
params.behavior: Keeps the oscillator at its ending frequency after the glide while continuing from the accumulated phase.

params.label: Waveform
params.behavior: Chooses the waveform evaluated from the analytically integrated phase; the saw uses the host's local edge correction.

params.label: Restart edge
params.behavior: Fades the beginning and end of each repeated event so its stateless phase restart does not click.

params.label: Stereo phase
params.behavior: Offsets the two channels around the same continuous glide phase.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the windowed stereo glide into a soft output ceiling.

entries.name: Normalized Route
entries.description: Adapts the atlas lane router to a graph cable: the incoming control is converted to 0–1, optionally inverted, then blended with a normalized fallback value.
entries.execution: Single-sample · graph input mapping · no lane buffer

params.label: Fallback
params.behavior: Sets the normalized value heard when routing amount is zero.

params.label: Route amount
params.behavior: Blends continuously from the fallback value to the normalized cable value.

params.label: Input domain
params.behavior: Chooses whether the incoming graph signal is remapped from −1…1 or already represents 0…1.

params.label: Direction
params.behavior: Reflects the normalized routed value around 0.5 before the depth blend.

entries.name: Linear Range Map
entries.description: Converts a normalized graph control into a chosen linear output range while retaining the atlas router's physical fallback and route-depth behavior.

params.label: Range start
params.behavior: Sets the output produced by a normalized value of zero; crossing the other endpoint reverses the mapping.

params.label: Range end
params.behavior: Sets the output produced by a normalized value of one; the mapping between endpoints stays linear.

params.label: Fallback
params.behavior: Sets the physical output used when route amount is zero, clamped within the selected endpoints.

params.label: Route amount
params.behavior: Blends in normalized space before converting to the selected physical range.

params.label: Input domain
params.behavior: Chooses whether the incoming graph signal is remapped from −1…1 or already represents 0…1.

params.label: Direction
params.behavior: Reflects the normalized routed input before it is mapped into the output range.

entries.name: Wavefold Table Oscillator
entries.description: Scans an analytic sine–triangle–saw family, evaluates up to eight symmetrically detuned layers, and passes every layer through a sine fold before stereo summing.

params.label: Frequency
params.behavior: Sets the center frequency before graph and performance-note transposition.

params.label: Table scan
params.behavior: Moves through the overlapping analytic sine, triangle, and saw regions.

params.label: Scan CV depth
params.behavior: Scales and optionally reverses the connected scan control before adding it to the table position.

params.label: Layers
params.behavior: Bounds the number of symmetrically detuned oscillator lanes evaluated for each sample.

params.label: Detune
params.behavior: Spreads the bounded layers symmetrically around the center pitch in cents.

params.label: Sine folds
params.behavior: Scales the scanned waveform before sine shaping; stronger values create additional folded lobes and can alias.

params.label: Stereo spread
params.behavior: Distributes detuned layers across an equal-power stereo field.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the square-root-normalized layer sum into a soft output ceiling.

entries.name: Cellular Automaton Score
entries.description: Evolves an elementary cellular-automaton row on the GPU. A moving read head turns live cells into gates, while cell position and neighborhood become quantized pitch.
entries.execution: Persistent GPU grid · ordered generation pass at event boundaries · active nodes only

params.label: Generation rate
params.behavior: Sets how often the automaton advances to a new row and the musical read head advances.

params.label: Rule
params.behavior: Selects the complete eight-entry elementary cellular-automaton transition table.

params.label: Active cells
params.behavior: Sets how many cells participate in wrapped neighbor evolution and pitch addressing.

params.label: Seed
params.behavior: Selects a repeatable initial population and resets this node's private state when changed.

params.label: Seed density
params.behavior: Sets the probability that each cell is alive in the seeded row.

params.label: Read stride
params.behavior: Changes which wrapped cell is read after every generation, producing different cycles from the same rule.

params.label: Pitch scale
params.behavior: Maps cell and neighborhood identity onto a musical pitch collection, including quarter-tone steps.

params.label: Pitch span
params.behavior: Sets how many octaves the active row can address.

entries.name: Reaction–Diffusion Score Lattice
entries.description: Evolves two coupled concentrations across a wrapped GPU surface. Patched X/Y coordinates sample its moving chemical field; contour strength supplies a related gate.
entries.execution: Persistent ping-pong GPU surface · bounded Gray–Scott update passes · active nodes only

params.label: Evolution speed
params.behavior: Scales the stable integration step without changing the audio sample clock.

params.label: Feed
params.behavior: Controls how quickly chemical A returns and changes the family of spots, stripes, and waves.

params.label: Kill
params.behavior: Controls chemical B removal and shifts the lattice between expanding, splitting, and vanishing structures.

params.label: A diffusion
params.behavior: Sets how quickly concentration A spreads into neighboring texture cells.

params.label: B diffusion
params.behavior: Sets B's independent diffusion rate and therefore the scale and stability of chemical features.

params.label: Surface zoom
params.behavior: Scales patched X/Y coordinates before wrapped texture sampling.

params.label: Contour threshold
params.behavior: Moves the field level around which the click-safe contour gate opens.

params.label: Seed
params.behavior: Selects repeatable initial perturbations and resets this node's surface when changed.

entries.name: Geometric Feedback Lattice
entries.description: Injects audio into a wrapped grid of delay cells. Rotated, repeatedly folded neighbor routes circulate the signal as a spatially patterned feedback network.
entries.execution: Ordered GPU state pass · persistent delay-cell surface · active nodes only

params.label: Lattice size
params.behavior: Sets the active square grid extent and therefore how many distinct circulation paths can form.

params.label: Cell delay
params.behavior: Sets propagation time between successive cell reads.

params.label: Feedback
params.behavior: Returns bounded cell output to the grid and controls decay length.

params.label: Neighbor coupling
params.behavior: Moves energy from each cell into its geometrically selected neighbors.

params.label: Route folds
params.behavior: Sets how many mirror-and-tile operations choose neighbor addresses.

params.label: Route rotation
params.behavior: Rotates the virtual lattice before folded neighbor lookup and changes circulation paths.

params.label: High damping
params.behavior: Averages adjacent state samples before feedback so repeated circulation loses high-frequency energy.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the current input to the bounded stereo lattice output.

entries.name: Spectral SDF
entries.description: Places bins from a bounded windowed DFT and successive analysis frames in a signed-distance coordinate field. The selected shape keeps, suppresses, or reflects regions before overlap-add resynthesis.
entries.execution: Dedicated GPU state pass · 64-band windowed DFT → SDF transform → overlap-add

params.label: Analysis window
params.behavior: Selects one of four exact power-of-two DFT windows, trading time localization for narrower band measurements.

params.label: Shape
params.behavior: Changes the signed-distance formula applied across bin and frame coordinates.

params.label: Shape extent
params.behavior: Scales the kept or transformed SDF region across time and frequency.

params.label: Shape rotation
params.behavior: Rotates frame/bin coordinates before distance evaluation and redirects diagonal spectral motion.

params.label: Boundary softness
params.behavior: Sets the antialiased distance band around the spectral shape boundary.

params.label: Shape depth
params.behavior: Controls whether the inside or outside dominates and how strongly the SDF mask changes bin magnitudes.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from latency-aligned input to overlap-added inverse-transform audio.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized resynthesis result before the wet/dry blend.

entries.name: Flow-field Advection
entries.description: Advects a persistent particle cloud through a curl-like vector field. Patched X/Y supplies a moving attractor; the output is the cloud centroid and anisotropy as two related controls.
entries.execution: Persistent GPU particle buffers · bounded advection and reduction passes · active nodes only

params.label: Advection speed
params.behavior: Scales the stable particle integration step.

params.label: Particles
params.behavior: Sets how many persistent particle lanes contribute to the reduced control outputs.

params.label: Field scale
params.behavior: Scales position before vector-field evaluation and changes the spatial size of curls.

params.label: Curl strength
params.behavior: Sets magnitude and direction of rotational acceleration around flow-field contours.

params.label: Momentum
params.behavior: Sets how much velocity survives into the next persistent update.

params.label: Attractor force
params.behavior: Pushes particles away from or toward the patched X/Y position.

params.label: Seed
params.behavior: Selects repeatable particle positions and resets this node's cloud when changed.

params.label: Output spread
params.behavior: Blends cloud-shape variance into the X/Y centroid outputs, increasing independent movement.

entries.name: Raymarch Resonator
entries.description: Raymarches a bounded signed-distance shape to derive path lengths and surface identities, then uses those measurements as frequencies and gains in a compact modal resonator bank.
entries.execution: Dedicated GPU state projection · bounded SDF rays + 48-mode recurrence · no texture grid

params.label: Modes
params.behavior: Sets how many ray-derived modal recurrences are evaluated and energy-normalized.

params.label: Shape
params.behavior: Changes the signed-distance geometry from which path lengths and surface weights are measured.

params.label: Body size
params.behavior: Scales ray path lengths and therefore shifts the complete modal frequency family.

params.label: Reflectivity
params.behavior: Sets how strongly later ray hits and modal recurrences retain energy.

params.label: High damping
params.behavior: Shortens higher modes relative to low ones and darkens the resonant tail.

params.label: Surface brightness
params.behavior: Tilts excitation weights across ray-derived modes without changing their frequencies.

params.label: Ray spread
params.behavior: Distributes surface identities and alternating ray directions across stereo.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from latency-aligned excitation to the bounded modal result.

entries.name: Sequence Lane
entries.description: Reads a persistent 128-value score lane with selectable generated patterns, sample-accurate swing, and click-safe interpolation between cells.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · persistent 128-step lane · active nodes only

params.label: Lane mode
params.behavior: Selects how the persistent lane is filled or traversed.

params.label: Step rate
params.behavior: Sets the sample-accurate lane advance rate when no external phase is connected.

params.label: Lane length
params.behavior: Sets the active wrapped region of the persistent score buffer.

params.label: Swing
params.behavior: Alternates adjacent step durations without moving the two-step boundary.

params.label: Cell glide
params.behavior: Interpolates lane values around cell boundaries while keeping gate timing exact.

params.label: Pattern seed
params.behavior: Selects repeatable generated cells and resets this lane when changed.

params.label: Value depth
params.behavior: Scales the stored or generated lane before output.

params.label: Value offset
params.behavior: Moves the complete lane above or below its stored center.

entries.name: Uploaded Wavetable
entries.description: Reads one periodic waveform from GPU storage, with interpolated phase, shape warping, and built-in timbre morphs without copying the table for every audio chunk.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · persistent uploaded table and stereo phase · active nodes only

params.label: Frequency
params.behavior: Sets the oscillator frequency before graph and performance-note transposition.

params.label: Table
params.behavior: Chooses a built-in table or one of three phase views of the resident uploaded waveform.

params.label: Shape scan
params.behavior: Morphs built-in timbres or bends phase through the single uploaded periodic waveform.

params.label: Scan CV
params.behavior: Scales and optionally reverses the connected scan control.

params.label: Interpolation
params.behavior: Chooses the number and shape of neighboring table reads used per sample.

params.label: Stereo detune
params.behavior: Offsets the left and right table phases with opposite pitch shifts.

params.label: Stereo width
params.behavior: Blends from one shared table read to independently phased left and right reads.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the interpolated table oscillator into its output ceiling.

entries.name: GPU Sampler / Granulator
entries.description: Shares one resident recording across one-shot, looped, scanned, frozen, and many-playhead granular modes, then reduces active grains into stereo.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · persistent sample + bounded 24-grain loop · active nodes only

params.label: Playback mode
params.behavior: Selects conventional playback or the grain scheduling strategy; notes or a rising Density / trigger input restart One-shot.

params.label: Playback rate
params.behavior: Sets playhead direction and resampling ratio before pitch input.

params.label: Position
params.behavior: Sets the base read position or center of the grain cloud.

params.label: Grain size
params.behavior: Sets each granular splice duration and its frequency-time resolution.

params.label: Grain density
params.behavior: Sets the bounded number of new playheads launched per second.

params.label: Position spread
params.behavior: Distributes grain read heads and pan positions around the base position.

params.label: Grain jitter
params.behavior: Randomizes each grain's read position while density continues to set its launch clock.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized sample or reduced grain cloud.

entries.name: Directional Spatializer
entries.description: Places an input with equal-power, first-order-field, analytic binaural-cue, and early-reflection room approximations.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · stereo delay ring + analytic directional cues · active nodes only

params.label: Spatial mode
params.behavior: Selects the analytic directional and reflection path.

params.label: Azimuth
params.behavior: Sets the horizontal source angle before connected azimuth modulation.

params.label: Elevation
params.behavior: Sets the vertical source angle before connected elevation modulation.

params.label: Distance
params.behavior: Applies a capped inverse-square-root amplitude law; it does not add propagation time.

params.label: Source width
params.behavior: Adds a short decorrelated stereo spread around the central source angle in every spatial mode.

params.label: Field detail
params.behavior: Changes directional weighting in FOA-style, binaural-cue, and room modes.

params.label: Cue profile
params.behavior: Selects one of four analytic interaural-delay and head-shadow profiles.

params.label: Spatial mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the original input to the decoded spatial result.

entries.name: Recursive Filter
entries.description: Runs DC blocking, biquad responses, or a state-variable topology through one ordered filter-state path with smooth coefficient transitions.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · persistent biquad / SVF recurrence · active nodes only

params.label: Filter mode
params.behavior: Selects the recursive coefficient and state topology.

params.label: Cutoff
params.behavior: Sets the high-pass corner in DC-blocker mode or the recursive filter frequency in the other modes.

params.label: Resonance
params.behavior: Controls energy around cutoff while the engine maintains a stable coefficient range.

params.label: Peak / shelf gain
params.behavior: Sets gain for peak and shelving modes; other modes leave it neutral.

params.label: Input drive
params.behavior: Pushes the recursive core while bounding state before it can destabilize.

params.label: Cutoff CV
params.behavior: Maps the first control input exponentially around cutoff.

params.label: Resonance CV
params.behavior: Scales the second control input before adding it to resonance.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from input to the selected recursive response.

entries.name: Feedback Network
entries.description: Shares one bounded circular history across recirculating echo, comb, all-pass, four/eight-tap diffusion fields, and nonlinear geometric feedback modes.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · circular delay + recirculating multi-tap field · active nodes only

params.label: Network mode
params.behavior: Selects the recirculating read and diffusion topology.

params.label: Delay time
params.behavior: Sets the base line length before decorrelation and time modulation.

params.label: Feedback
params.behavior: Controls returned network energy below the bounded stability ceiling.

params.label: Diffusion
params.behavior: Changes the coefficient in All-pass mode and the cross-line blend in the tap-field modes.

params.label: High damping
params.behavior: Removes high-frequency energy on every circulation.

params.label: Modulation rate
params.behavior: Moves decorrelated delay reads to reduce stationary ringing.

params.label: Modulation depth
params.behavior: Sets delay-time excursion around each network line.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the current input to the recirculating network output.

entries.name: Wavefield Solver
entries.description: Uses one conditional grid-state family for delay-line strings, nonlinear strings, membranes, plates, rooms, and directional waveguide meshes.
entries.execution: Persistent ping-pong wavefield · cell-parallel block updates with audio-rate interpolation · active nodes only

params.label: Physical model
params.behavior: Selects dimensionality, neighborhood, and boundary update rules.

params.label: Propagation
params.behavior: Changes the wave-step coefficient; performance-note pitch shifts this control, but the lattice modes are not calibrated oscillators in hertz.

params.label: Field size
params.behavior: Shifts the simulated propagation scale; Grid side separately controls the number and density of cells.

params.label: Grid side
params.behavior: Sets one side of the active square; every setting maps to a distinct 16–256-cell surface.

params.label: Material
params.behavior: Moves loss, dispersion, stiffness, and nonlinear tension together.

params.label: Damping
params.behavior: Removes energy on propagation while preserving a stable time step.

params.label: Pickup position
params.behavior: Moves the sampled point or stereo pair across the simulated field.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the excitation to the simulated body or room response.

entries.name: Spectral Transport
entries.description: Uses 32 persistent complex resonator bands and phase-carried oscillator resynthesis for compact remap, pitch, envelope-time, freeze, robot, and gate treatments.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · 32 complex resonators + phase-carried resynthesis · active nodes only

params.label: Spectral mode
params.behavior: Selects the 32-band approximation applied between resonator analysis and oscillator reconstruction.

params.label: Band memory
params.behavior: Changes the decay and selectivity of each persistent resonator band.

params.label: Band response
params.behavior: Changes how tightly band memory follows the incoming signal.

params.label: Pitch ratio
params.behavior: Moves reconstructed resonator frequencies independently from envelope timing.

params.label: Envelope time
params.behavior: Slows or accelerates spectral-envelope response without dividing oscillator pitch.

params.label: Phase coherence
params.behavior: Blends each band's analyzed phase toward its continuous oscillator phase.

params.label: Spectral detail
params.behavior: Tilts band weighting and sets the spectral-gate threshold; it is not a flux reset.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from current input to the compact resonator-bank output.

entries.name: Dynamics
entries.description: Tracks sample peaks or a four-point quadratic intersample estimate through a persistent gain envelope for compression, limiting, expansion, gating, or level riding.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · detector/envelope recurrence + lookahead ring · active nodes only

params.label: Dynamics mode
params.behavior: Selects the static gain curve and detector strategy.

params.label: Threshold
params.behavior: Sets the detector level at which the selected gain curve begins.

params.label: Ratio
params.behavior: Sets compression or expansion strength; Limiter uses a fixed steep ratio, while Gate and Level rider use their own curves.

params.label: Attack
params.behavior: Sets how quickly the persistent gain state responds to increasing level.

params.label: Release
params.behavior: Sets how quickly gain returns after the detector falls.

params.label: Knee
params.behavior: Rounds compressor, limiter, and expander curves around threshold; Gate and Level rider do not use it.

params.label: Lookahead
params.behavior: Delays output behind the detector so gain can respond before a peak arrives.

params.label: Makeup gain
params.behavior: Applies output gain after the dynamics envelope.

entries.name: Convolution Space
entries.description: Samples 24–56 taps from a 12-second GPU history ring for cabinet, body, resonator, room, and uploaded-IR approximations.
entries.execution: 64-lane sample blocks · synchronized 12-second history + 24/40/56 sparse IR taps · active nodes only

params.label: Space mode
params.behavior: Selects tap spacing and the intended response family.

params.label: Impulse response
params.behavior: Chooses a procedural response, the uploaded stereo channels, or a widened cross-channel version of that response.

params.label: IR size
params.behavior: Resamples the response in time before connected size modulation.

params.label: Pre-delay
params.behavior: Offsets the convolved response without altering its internal decay.

params.label: Tail decay
params.behavior: Applies a stable envelope across response partitions.

params.label: Tail tone
params.behavior: Tilts or damps later impulse-response partitions.

params.label: Stereo width
params.behavior: Crossfades from a mono-summed response to channel-specific gains and decorrelated tap positions.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from latency-aligned input to the complete convolution result.

entries.name: Massive Bank
entries.description: Uses closed-form structured oscillator sums up to one million lanes, plus a bounded 128-state modal or nonlinear resonator bank.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · closed-form bank sums or 128-mode recurrence · active nodes only

params.label: Bank mode
params.behavior: Selects oscillator or recurrence state for each parallel bank lane.

params.label: Root frequency
params.behavior: Sets the common frequency reference before pitch input.

params.label: Bank lanes
params.behavior: Sets the analytic structured-oscillator count; modal and resonator modes use the bounded resident mode bank.

params.label: Frequency spread
params.behavior: Distributes oscillator or resonator frequencies around the root and also widens their stereo reduction.

params.label: Inharmonicity
params.behavior: Moves partial and mode ratios away from integer alignment.

params.label: Mode decay
params.behavior: Sets persistent decay for modal and resonator modes.

params.label: Spectral tilt
params.behavior: Weights high or low bank elements before reduction.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the normalized tree-reduction result.

entries.name: Audio Analysis Field
entries.description: Adapts ShaderToy's audio-field idea into a persistent GPU waveform ring plus periodic scalar feature reductions, then exposes one feature and threshold gate to the graph.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · waveform ring + periodic scalar reductions · active nodes only

params.label: Feature
params.behavior: Chooses one direct or periodically reduced measurement for the field output.

params.label: Analysis window
params.behavior: Sets the waveform-history span used by the reductions.

params.label: Low probe
params.behavior: Sets the lower of three sinusoidal energy probes.

params.label: High probe
params.behavior: Sets the upper probe; the center probe is their geometric mean.

params.label: Smoothing
params.behavior: Carries feature values across chunks to suppress block flicker.

params.label: Gate threshold
params.behavior: Opens the gate while the selected, smoothed feature remains above this value.

params.label: Feature gain
params.behavior: Scales the selected feature before output.

params.label: Feature offset
params.behavior: Offsets the selected feature without changing event measurement.

entries.name: DDSP Resynth
entries.description: Decodes pitch, loudness, and timbre controls into editable harmonic or inharmonic oscillators plus a four-band filtered-noise spectrum.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · 64 carried partial phases + four persistent noise filters · active nodes only

params.label: Decoder mode
params.behavior: Selects which interpretable oscillator and noise components are active.

params.label: Base frequency
params.behavior: Sets decoder pitch before connected pitch trajectories and performance notes.

params.label: Harmonics
params.behavior: Sets the bounded harmonic bank size.

params.label: Noise amount
params.behavior: Balances harmonic decoding with the four-band filtered-noise bank.

params.label: Brightness
params.behavior: Tilts harmonic amplitudes and noise magnitudes together.

params.label: Inharmonicity
params.behavior: Offsets oscillator ratios while retaining continuous phase.

params.label: Spectral formant
params.behavior: Moves a broad envelope across both harmonic and noise components.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales the complete harmonic-plus-noise decoder.

entries.name: Spectral Vocoder
entries.description: Runs a 32-channel vocoder: paired modulator/carrier bandpass filters track envelopes, then transfer them across shifted carrier bands.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · two 32-band filter passes + envelope state · active nodes only

params.label: Vocoder mode
params.behavior: Selects envelope, magnitude, phase, and persistence strategy.

params.label: Envelope bands
params.behavior: Sets frequency resolution of the resident modulator-envelope bank.

params.label: Band width
params.behavior: Changes the bandwidth of both modulator and carrier channel filters.

params.label: Envelope attack
params.behavior: Sets how quickly each spectral band follows increasing modulator energy.

params.label: Envelope release
params.behavior: Sets how long each band retains its envelope after energy falls.

params.label: Envelope shift
params.behavior: Moves the transferred envelope across carrier frequency bins.

params.label: Envelope contrast
params.behavior: Curves band envelopes to trade smoothness for articulation.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from the modulator input to reconstructed vocoder audio.

entries.name: Neural Processor
entries.description: Runs a compact fixed-weight dilated stack or recurrent neural-style state model with patchable conditioning; model upload is not implied.
entries.execution: Ordered state pass · fixed coefficients + receptive/recurrent state · active nodes only

params.label: Model
params.behavior: Selects one of six fixed compact network topologies.

params.label: Network width
params.behavior: Selects the active dilated-tap count or recurrent hidden-unit count inside the fixed allocation.

params.label: Input drive
params.behavior: Scales audio entering the fixed-weight transformation.

params.label: Memory
params.behavior: Continuously stretches dilated-history reads or increases recurrent-state retention, depending on the selected model.

params.label: Condition
params.behavior: Sets the base network-control value before graph conditioning.

params.label: Condition CV
params.behavior: Scales the connected conditioning control.

params.label: Wet mix
params.behavior: Crossfades from input to the compact network output.

params.label: Level
params.behavior: Scales and bounds the final model result.

entries.name: Output
entries.description: Collects the graph's final stereo signal, applies output gain, and limits extreme peaks before readback.

params.label: Shader level
params.behavior: Sets the level written by the shader before the page's master output control.

params.label: Soft ceiling
params.behavior: Sets the maximum PCM magnitude after soft limiting.

entries.label: Lesiba / gora
entries.description: A flattened quill converts forceful inhalation and exhalation into transverse string motion; the mouth selects harmonics from the sounding string.
entries.modelNote: Signed Bernoulli-style quill forcing drives a lossy harmonic string. Inhalation and exhalation use different quill phase and spectral loading.

entries.label: Harmonica
entries.description: Blow and draw pressure select opposing free reeds. The vocal tract feeds a strongly nonlinear, player-controlled acoustic load back to the reeds.
entries.modelNote: Pressure-controlled reed oscillators use a nonlinear opening/flow curve and direction-dependent reed banks.

entries.label: Khaen
entries.description: A mouth chamber distributes inhaled or exhaled flow through bamboo pipes whose free reeds sound in either direction.
entries.modelNote: Bidirectional reed valves feed a multi-pipe modal bank; breath direction changes attack and spectral balance without stopping the chord.

entries.label: Sheng
entries.description: Metal free reeds mounted in a wind chamber couple to tuned bamboo pipes and respond on both blown and drawn airflow.
entries.modelNote: A bidirectional free-reed bank is coupled to pipe modes; chamber and mouth impedances color the radiated chord.

entries.label: Shō
entries.description: Seventeen slender pipes form sustained aitake tone clusters, maintained through alternating outward and inward breath.
entries.modelNote: Long-attack bidirectional reeds excite a bright, tightly spaced pipe cluster; direction alters the transient more than pitch.

entries.label: Hulusi
entries.description: Exhaled air enters a gourd wind chest and drives a melody-pipe free reed plus one or more drone pipes.
entries.modelNote: An outward-pressure reed valve feeds one fingered pipe and two weak drone resonances through a shared chamber.

entries.label: Bawu
entries.description: A side-blown bamboo pipe uses an enclosed free reed as its pressure valve, with finger holes setting the air-column resonance.
entries.modelNote: One outward-driven reed is impedance-locked to a lossy pipe mode and colored by the mouth cavity upstream.

entries.label: Didgeridoo / yidaki
entries.description: Exhaled pressure opens and closes the lips against a long irregular bore while the player's vocal-tract impedance sculpts its spectral peaks.
entries.modelNote: A pressure-driven lip valve feeds odd bore modes; movable vocal-tract impedance notches and glottal pulses reshape the drone.

entries.label: Pungi / been
entries.description: Continuous exhalation pressurizes a gourd reservoir that supplies a melody reed and drone reed in parallel pipes.
entries.modelNote: A smoothed reservoir pressure drives paired beating reeds, one fingered and one droning, through gourd resonances.

entries.label: Nose flute
entries.description: A controlled nasal jet crosses an edge and locks to a bamboo air column; mouth volume can indirectly alter upstream pressure and phrasing.
entries.modelNote: Jet-delay oscillation is approximated by a noisy edge-tone source locked to pipe modes; only exhalation excites it.

entries.label: Overtone flute
entries.description: A narrow end-blown pipe changes register primarily through breath pressure, exposing successive air-column modes without finger holes.
entries.modelNote: Jet speed moves the strongest coupling window upward through a harmonic pipe bank, producing pressure-selected registers.

entries.label: ʻUkeke
entries.description: Three strings are plucked while the lips and oral cavity act as a moving resonator, silently articulating changes in timbre.
entries.modelNote: A plucked modal string bank decays independently; signed breath changes acoustic loading and turbulence, not the initial excitation.

entries.label: Umrhubhe
entries.description: A friction stick excites the bow string while the mouth cavity selects and amplifies harmonics from the sustained vibration.
entries.modelNote: Stick-slip forcing sustains a string modal bank; the mouth resonator supplies the strongest audible spectral movement.

entries.label: Lunku mouth bow
entries.description: A twanged string supplies a harmonic spectrum while the bow is pressed to the mouth, turning the oral cavity into its resonator.
entries.modelNote: A short pluck excites string modes; jaw, tongue, and lip controls move the radiating formants.

entries.label: Berimbau-de-boca
entries.description: Unlike the gourd-resonated capoeira berimbau, this mouth-bow form couples its plucked string directly to a changing oral resonator.
entries.modelNote: Plucked string modes feed a vowel-like impedance filter; breath adds load and aspiration but does not replace the pluck.

entries.label: K’ni
entries.description: A bowed string sends vibration along a cord held at the mouth; the player's oral cavity becomes a highly articulate remote resonator.
entries.modelNote: Bowed stick-slip energy sustains string modes and a coupling cord injects them into movable oral formants.

entries.label: Makomako jaw harp
entries.description: A split-bamboo lamella is finger-excited at the lips; inhaled and exhaled air load its motion differently while the mouth selects harmonics.
entries.modelNote: A plucked lamella supplies the initial energy and signed pressure sustains, bends, and redistributes its harmonic modes.

entries.label: Mukkuri
entries.description: A cord-plucked bamboo tongue vibrates before the mouth, whose shape and alternating airflow reveal and animate its upper partials.
entries.modelNote: A plucked bamboo lamella is pressure-loaded in both directions and radiated through a movable three-formant cavity.

entries.label: Đàn môi
entries.description: A light brass lamella rests against the lips rather than the teeth; pluck, signed airflow, and oral articulation all strongly affect its sound.
entries.modelNote: A bright plucked lamella receives bidirectional aerodynamic sustain and close-coupled vocal-tract filtering.
